verdict.rationale: Thoropass's official MCP server lets the assistant work in the workspace "within limits you set". The docs also tell users to add or remove items "depending on what you want your agent to be able to do", which suggests per-agent scoping of capabilities. However, the evidence never shows actual API credentials or tokens being issued, or what the scopes are. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of issuing API keys/tokens for agents, a defined scope/permission model, revocation/rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
